title: Spare Capacity
description: Capture a reserve controller that reports no spare power.
objective: Recover evidence at Authoritative record / Capture controller at Response controller
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: Its reserve is real. The allocation is being sold to an unnamed continuity fund.

lore.title: Spare Capacity / Unsent message
lore.text: SABLE / community grid engineer: Capture a reserve controller that reports no spare power. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Spare Capacity / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Spare Capacity: Its reserve is real. The allocation is being sold to an unnamed continuity fund. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.text: Personal note filed under spare-capacity: Its reserve is real. The allocation is being sold to an unnamed continuity fund. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.
